instruction.text: This map shows the location of the alpine biomes around the world. What do you notice about their location?

b: ++They are found in mountainous regions worldwide.
They are only found in the Southern Hemisphere.
They are only found in Africa.

atoms.a: Looking at the image, what do you think the climate in alpine biomes is like?
atoms.sound: Looking at the image, what do you think the climate in alpine byeohms is like?

atoms.b: At a certain point on a mountain, it becomes too cold for ((rocks ++trees)) to survive. This is marked by the tree line.
Alpine biomes are found above the ((plant_line ++tree_line)), where the temperatures become extremely cold.

instruction.text: Ibexes are a breed of goat that live in alpine biomes. Select the two ways that they have adapted.

b: ++They have strong, robust limbs to help them walk around the uneven mountains.
++They dig burrows in the snow to protect themselves from the wind and cold.
They have a short tail to help them catch prey.

instruction.text: Plants also have to adapt to alpine biomes. How do these adaptations help plants to survive in the mountains?

atoms.b: traps a layer of air to insulate the plant
reduces the area of the plant that is exposed to the harsh conditions
allows them to share resources and help each other stay alive

instruction.text: Drag the mountains onto the Himalayas to find out more.

atoms.b: The Himalayas are a ((beach ++mountain)) range in Asia that make up a large amount of our planet’s alpine biome.
atoms.sound: The Himalayas are a mountain range in Asia that make up a large amount of our planet’s alpine bye-ohm.

atoms.b: They are also home to Mount Everest, which is the ((lowest ++highest)) mountain in the world.
